$meta.title: OML lattice form — finite-trace σ-liftability
$meta.purpose: Zoom-out index of the OML/lattice attack. Load this first; follow detail pointers into the working note for proofs, scope, and session receipts.
$meta.what_is_it: Does every finitely additive two-valued state on a concrete σ-complete OML have each finite trace reproduced by some σ-additive two-valued state?
$meta.status: OPEN — conjectured latticehood implies Φ; no proof or OML counterexample.
$meta.the_shape: Φ is density of σ-additive states inside finitely additive states, not equality. Compact eligible local slices imply eventwise selection, so any bad face needs a noncompact slice. One- and two-atom interval inflations of the centre-free seven-block skeleton remain Phi-tame: every jointly coherent distinct atom pair has disjoint propagation supports, so even a five-cycle carries a rectangular relation. A genuine obstruction must use non-atomic intervals or proper shared subalgebras that make one completed block see both coordinates.

headline.current_next_step: Classify non-atomic selector intervals and proper shared-subalgebra embeddings in the seven-block skeleton; test the smallest coherent pair whose completion creates a block seeing both fibre coordinates.

reductions.name: Finite-trace σ-liftability Φ
reductions.one_line: Φ(L): every finite trace realized by a global finitely additive two-valued state is realized by some global σ-additive two-valued state.

reductions.name: Φ as Stone density
reductions.one_line: Φ(L) iff St_σ(L) is dense in St_fa(L) inside {0,1}^L; equality of the two state spaces is not required.
reductions.lean: ConcreteOMLPatterns.lean (2026-07-11 s18): phi_iff_dense machine-checked axiom-free -- Phi iff St_sigma dense in St_fa on the Cantor cube over the carrier; plus isClosed_stFA (f.a. states = closed constraint set, kit gap 4.2(a)) and isCompact_stFA (Tychonoff). Also phi_iff_phiCluster (cluster form, latticehood-free both ways) + cluster_extension

reductions.name: Blockwise gluing reduction
reductions.one_line: σ-additivity is blockwise, so global σ-states are exactly coherent choices of σ-states across Boolean blocks.
reductions.lean: ConcreteOMLBlocks.lean (2026-07-11 s17): A1a exists_isMaxBlock_superset, A1b IsMaxBlock.{empty,univ,compl,iUnion}_mem, A1c isSigmaOn_carrier_iff_maxBlocks -- axiom-free (classical base only), #print axioms receipts in file

reductions.name: General relational boundary descent
reductions.one_line: Phi is equivalent to choosing one finitely additive extension whose trace on every overlap-generated boundary admits a pattern-preserving local sigma lift; matching all lifts to that common trace makes them glue.

reductions.name: Genuine OML dense-nonopen boundary
reductions.one_line: A countable-coordinate sigma-field times MO2 is a concrete sigma-complete OML with two maximal blocks whose actual sigma-field boundary has dense nonopen point and sigma-liftable loci, already on a one-event face; one private Boolean generator suffices.

reductions.name: Compact local sigma-selection
reductions.one_line: If every eligible local sigma-state slice for a coherent finite face is compact, the face sigma-lifts: a global finitely additive witness makes every finite family of eventwise overlap equations solvable by local Dirac states. Thus every bad face has a noncompact eligible slice.

reductions.name: Irreducible boundary realization skeleton
reductions.one_line: Every two-block interface is central, but completing two crossed interfaces intervalwise produces a 56-event centre-free concrete sigma-complete OML with seven maximal blocks; every generated boundary equals its full block.

reductions.name: Seven-block common-base inflation dichotomy
reductions.one_line: A times L* is a concrete sigma-complete OML with exactly the seven inflated blocks, saturated boundaries, and face-exposed dense-nonopen local sigma topology, but its centre is A times {0,1}; every nontrivial common-base inflation is therefore reducible.

reductions.name: Distributed one-interval inflation
reductions.one_line: Replacing q0 by one Boolean fibre propagates through exactly B,D0,D1; the closure has seven maximal blocks, trivial centre, saturated boundaries, and a face-exposed noncompact sigma slice, but every finite face sigma-lifts by fibrewise replacement.

reductions.name: Two-fibre atom-substitution no-go
reductions.one_line: Every atom jointly chargeable with q0 has disjoint propagation support. The smallest pair occupies a five-cycle and closes as a centre-free seven-block OML, but its fibre relation is the full product, monodromy is identity, and independent point replacement proves Phi-tameness.

reductions.name: Two-block rescue
reductions.one_line: A coherent value-1 pattern supported in at most two blocks is Dirac-rescued; any witness needs at least three blocks.
reductions.lean: ConcreteOMLPatterns.lean (2026-07-11 s18): two_block_rescue machine-checked axiom-free -- value-1 part covered by two maximal blocks implies Dirac-rescued; only use of latticehood is A2 in-block inter-closure (val_finsetInf), exactly as the note says

reductions.name: Cluster normal form
reductions.one_line: The open frontier reduces to coherent clusters of at least three pairwise-incompatible block-meets with pairwise intersections but empty global kernel.

reductions.name: Fine/coarse factorization
reductions.one_line: The lattice question factors into B′(i) for countably generated blocks and a separate coarse-block coherence question.

reductions.name: T4 as Stone projection
reductions.one_line: T4 holds exactly when each cluster face reaches a principal block atom; for countably generated blocks this is equivalent to nonempty restriction-image interior and to the proposed basic-open interpolation form.

reductions.name: Finite-generator tree and σ-completion gap
reductions.one_line: Finite feasible branches determine only generator-algebra traces, not f.a. ultrafilters on the generated σ-field; their compact fibres expose the missing atom-charge step rather than proving T4.

reductions.name: Finite-atlas full-block localization
reductions.one_line: For finitely many countably generated blocks, absence of a global sigma-state localizes after a finite face refinement to one block whose full restriction is non-sigma; this is not boundary-defect localization.

reductions.name: Boundary-defect topological regularity
reductions.one_line: A finite distributed boundary-defect cover localizes if each sigma-liftable locus is open on the relevant face restriction image; finite/discrete and compact/proper-image cases work, but countable generation alone does not.

reductions.name: Distributed boundary defect
reductions.one_line: Failure of Phi gives forall-state exists-block boundary failure, not one block bad for all states; the executable three-point model refutes only unrefined local trapping and localizes on singleton refinements.

fine_block_route.name: B′(i): countably generated blocks imply Φ
fine_block_route.one_line: On carriers whose blocks are countably generated, prove that every finitely coherent finite trace has a coherent pointed global realization.

fine_block_route.name: Pointed-state density
fine_block_route.one_line: B′(i) is equivalent to density of blockwise-pointed states among finitely additive two-valued states.

fine_block_route.name: One-block repointing crux
fine_block_route.one_line: Given a coherent cluster plus existing block pointings, can one point one further block while preserving finite-additive coherence?

fine_block_route.name: T4 finitary shadow
fine_block_route.one_line: Every coherent cluster must admit a coherent atom from each further block; necessary for B′(i), but insufficient without a completion principle.

fine_block_route.name: Finite-stage fibre saturation
fine_block_route.one_line: FS plus a branch carrier proves T4, but FS is exactly universal principality of the whole branch fibre and fails even in a complete Boolean algebra containing a principal state on that branch.

coarse_block_route.name: B′(ii): coarse-block coherence
coarse_block_route.one_line: Adds the local problem of characterizing and selecting non-point sigma lifts on coarse boundaries; arbitrary-atlas simultaneous selection is a separate cross-cutting issue shared with B′(i).

coarse_block_route.name: Non-principal block σ-states
coarse_block_route.one_line: Coarse σ-fields can carry non-principal two-valued σ-states, so point-selection does not describe the entire σ-side.

coarse_block_route.name: DW/Maharam regularization
coarse_block_route.one_line: Inner regularity plus a common intersection-stable compact witness can upgrade finite additivity, but representability alone does not supply that witness.

unitality_route.name: PP1994 unitality/subadditivity engine
unitality_route.one_line: A sufficiently separating unital subadditive family of σ-states could force Booleanity and thereby constrain a counterexample.

unitality_route.name: Universal JP forcing
unitality_route.one_line: Latticehood does not force every σ-state to be Jauch–Piron; MO₂ refutes the first formulation, leaving only narrower hypotheses.

counterexample_construction.name: Coarse-block toy
counterexample_construction.one_line: First build a concrete σ-class OML with a genuinely coarse block, incompatible overlap, and a non-principal blockwise σ-state.

counterexample_construction.name: T4 counterexample hunt
counterexample_construction.one_line: A coherent cluster and further block violating T4 would refute B′(i) outright.

counterexample_construction.name: Pentagon contextual atom-kill cell
counterexample_construction.one_line: A three-input pattern in the finite Greechie pentagon uniquely and contextually forces a fourth incompatible atom to zero; the obstacle is countable high-girth assembly, not a single OML cell.

counterexample_construction.name: Pentagon serial relay
counterexample_construction.one_line: The pentagon propagates a 1/0 signal, but its outputs are co-contextual; direct serial identification creates a three-loop, as does using master-block targets as the zero rail.

counterexample_construction.name: Spaced-master pentagon relay
counterexample_construction.one_line: The relay/free state extends blockwise, but its absorbing regime is forced by a two-element trace that no σ-state realizes, so σ-states create a false order and cannot give a concrete representation.

counterexample_construction.name: Essential ternary trigger
counterexample_construction.one_line: The pentagon has 45 essential ternary triggers; a master-ready variant forces atom a9 to zero while every proper input subset permits both target values.

counterexample_construction.name: Indirect two-overlap ternary relay
counterexample_construction.one_line: The relay is finitely essential and structurally complete, but one required order witness enters the absorbing free basin and has no principal-master continuation, so σ-states impose a false order.

counterexample_construction.name: All-odd removable-state relay
counterexample_construction.one_line: The all-odd state is uniquely removable, but every two-port relay either makes it σ-live (so T4 holds) or loses other indispensable order witnesses; no map passes the corrected local screen.

counterexample_construction.name: ω-live σ-state separation screen
counterexample_construction.one_line: A relay candidate must have σ-live automaton states order-determine every cell and compatible σ-live paths separate cross-cell non-orders; finite proper-trace escape is insufficient.

counterexample_construction.name: Full concrete OML witness
counterexample_construction.one_line: Construct L in the admissible concrete σ-complete OML class with a finite trace in im St_fa but outside im St_σ.

counterexample_construction.name: Two-cell k>=3 identifications
counterexample_construction.one_line: Two-cell route complete. k>=6 has no girth-valid map; k=4,5 die at the screen; k=3 gives four screen-survivors with the ideal ten-state live set but all four die downstream, two at global girth and two at master-cycle girth. Liveness is independently validated by a rooted product-graph oracle; the late s33 alarm confused the one-sided model with a two-sided convention.

counterexample_construction.name: Three-pentagon period-3 relays
counterexample_construction.one_line: One-port period-3 relays: unconditional no-go (full 10^6 product, zero survivors at every phase). Two-port: no-go within the s_*-preserving design class (275^3 = 2.08e7 triples, zero survivors at every phase); outside that design class remains open. Liveness is independently validated under the stated one-sided convention.

counterexample_construction.name: Richer removable-face relays
counterexample_construction.one_line: For the 7-loop face C={a0,a3,a11}, period-one injective ports k<=4, period-two ports k<=2, and period-three width one are closed. Session 38 exhausts 7,529,536 triples with zero operative survivors.

mechanism_exclusions.name: Singleton quarantine
mechanism_exclusions.one_line: Fine singleton rigidity of the product-Ulam type destroys latticehood; this excludes that mechanism, not every possible OML witness.

mechanism_exclusions.name: Boolean-or-horizontal overlap dichotomy
mechanism_exclusions.one_line: The finite Greechie pentagon refutes the proposed structural dichotomy while satisfying Φ automatically.

mechanism_exclusions.name: Disjoint-union-only overlaps
mechanism_exclusions.one_line: Blocks and their overlaps in the concrete σ-class OML setting are σ-fields, so the OMP witness's overlap geometry cannot persist.
mechanism_exclusions.lean: ConcreteOMLBlocks.lean (2026-07-11 s17-s18): A2 FULLY machine-checked, AXIOM-FREE -- IsMaxBlock.inter_mem + toMeasurableSpace (blocks are sigma-fields) + overlapMeasurableSpace (overlaps are sigma-fields). The anticipated Foulis-Holland axiom proved unnecessary: meet squeeze compat_of_locally_resolved + set distributivity gives commutant closure (compat_inter_left); Bruns-Harding now cited for the abstract theorem only

mechanism_exclusions.name: Polish representation alone
mechanism_exclusions.one_line: Polish representability without in-block regularity and a shared compact witness does not prove Φ.

mechanism_exclusions.name: Empty kernel as intrinsic obstruction
mechanism_exclusions.one_line: K(s)=∅ depends on the chosen concrete representation and cannot classify the abstract OML state by itself.

mechanism_exclusions.name: Maharam (8.2) for one-block repointing
mechanism_exclusions.one_line: Every empty-kernel cluster violates (8.2) before a new atom is chosen, so classical positive set-field gluing is too strong to decide T4.

mechanism_exclusions.name: Finite compatible carrier atom-killing
mechanism_exclusions.one_line: An all-remainder construction cannot kill every atom of a countably atomic block using one reused value-one carrier or finitely many jointly compatible carrier certificates.

mechanism_exclusions.name: Affine shared-tail atom killing
mechanism_exclusions.one_line: Paired exact-one equations with a shared partition tail force literal equality of their distinguished carrier sets, so chains of such cancellations reduce to the reused-carrier obstruction.

mechanism_exclusions.name: Four-loop contextual propagation
mechanism_exclusions.one_line: The smallest separated cyclic exact-one implication gadget is a concrete σ-class OMP but not a lattice; opposite atoms have two incomparable minimal upper bounds.

mechanism_exclusions.name: Direct pentagon fan-out
mechanism_exclusions.one_line: Two private pentagon cells sharing a distance-two input pair create an induced four-loop; the obstruction is sharp and does not cover one-port serial cactus assemblies.

mechanism_exclusions.name: Exact-one cloning on incidence forests
mechanism_exclusions.one_line: With one 1/0 seed pair, unit propagation on a finite linear incidence forest can create at most one fresh value-one vertex; repeatable propagation requires a cycle.

mechanism_exclusions.name: Fresh explicit three-port two-cell relay
mechanism_exclusions.one_line: Among all 24 fresh value-compatible three-port pentagon maps, none is both essential and girth five; indirect two-overlap conversion remains possible.

mechanism_exclusions.name: Pentagon essential ternary absorbing faces
mechanism_exclusions.one_line: All 45 essential ternary trigger fibres exclude the uniquely removable state and contain an indispensable order witness, so making them nonprincipal destroys σ-state order separation.

mechanism_exclusions.name: Pentagon two-port removable-state relays
mechanism_exclusions.one_line: Of 4,050 maps, 45 are girth-five with a free but non-σ-live all-odd state; none retain local order determination, so the whole two-port class is eliminated.

external_sufficient_conditions.name: Finite carriers
external_sufficient_conditions.one_line: Finite carriers satisfy Φ because finite and countable additivity coincide.

external_sufficient_conditions.name: Horizontal sums
external_sufficient_conditions.one_line: Horizontal-sum-like carriers lie in the known tame region, though they do not exhaust concrete irreducible OMLs.

external_sufficient_conditions.name: Finite-interface quarantine
external_sufficient_conditions.one_line: Lean proves that finite raw overlap families at every maximal block force every finitely coherent pattern to have a global sigma-additive two-valued extension; the equivalent finite generated-boundary formulation remains an elementary hand step.
